title: Analytic: PEC cavity resonances (E_z and H_z)
description:
A lossless PEC rectangular cavity rung by a gaussian pulse, once in E_z (physics 'em') and once in H_z (physics 'em_hz') (FDTD).
Analytic: f_mn = c/2 sqrt((m/a)^2 + (n/b)^2); E_z (TM) modes need m, n >= 1, H_z (TE) modes m, n >= 0 (not both 0), each with its own cavity size.
Probes tab: FFT of em.probe (peaks at f11_ez, f21_ez, f12_ez, ...) and of em_hz.probe (f10_hz, f01_hz, f11_hz).
Derived values tab: A11_ez_lockin, B10_hz_lockin etc. vs their references.
DFT tab: em.map_11 / em.map_21 = the sin*sin mode patterns; em_hz.map_10 / em_hz.map_11 (quantity hz_intensity) = the cos*cos patterns.

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration (ring-down of the lossless cavity)

parameters.name: T_lock
parameters.description: start of the lock-in window (after both pulses ended)

parameters.name: bw
parameters.description: relative bandwidth of both gaussian sources

parameters.name: K_src
parameters.description: H_z point source magnetic line current [V]

parameters.name: a_ez
parameters.description: E_z cavity width: pec pins E_z at the centres of the outermost cells, so the walls are dx/2 inside the domain

parameters.name: a_hz
parameters.description: H_z cavity width: pec pins tangential E on the inner faces of the outermost cells, one cell inside the domain

parameters.name: xs_ez
parameters.description: E_z source distance from the x_lo wall plane

parameters.name: ys_ez
parameters.description: E_z source distance from the y_lo wall plane

parameters.name: xp_ez
parameters.description: E_z probe distance from the x_lo wall plane

parameters.name: yp_ez
parameters.description: E_z probe distance from the y_lo wall plane

parameters.name: xs_hz
parameters.description: H_z source distance from the x_lo wall plane

parameters.name: ys_hz
parameters.description: H_z source distance from the y_lo wall plane

parameters.name: xp_hz
parameters.description: H_z probe distance from the x_lo wall plane

parameters.name: yp_hz
parameters.description: H_z probe distance from the y_lo wall plane

parameters.name: lambda0_ez
parameters.description: E_z source centre wavelength (covers f11, f21, f12)

parameters.name: lambda0_hz
parameters.description: H_z source centre wavelength (covers f10, f01, f11)

parameters.name: t0_ez
parameters.description: E_z pulse centre [s]; the carrier is sin(2 pi f0 (t - t0))

parameters.name: f11_ez
parameters.description: E_z (TM) mode 1,1 [Hz]: f_mn = c/2 sqrt((m/a)^2 + (n/b)^2), m, n >= 1

parameters.name: f10_hz
parameters.description: H_z (TE) mode 1,0 [Hz]: f_mn as for E_z with m, n >= 0 (not both 0) and the H_z cavity size

parameters.name: A11_ez
parameters.description: ring-down amplitude [V/m] of mode 1,1 at the probe: E_z = sum A_mn sin(2 pi f_mn (t - t0)), A_mn = psi_mn(source) psi_mn(probe) I G(f_mn) / (2 eps0), psi normalised sin*sin, G the gaussian's envelope spectrum

parameters.name: A21_ez
parameters.description: ring-down amplitude [V/m] of E_z mode 2,1 at the probe

parameters.name: A12_ez
parameters.description: ring-down amplitude [V/m] of E_z mode 1,2 at the probe

parameters.name: B10_hz
parameters.description: ring-down amplitude [A/m] of H_z mode 1,0 at the probe: H_z = sum B_mn sin(2 pi f_mn (t - t0)), B_mn = phi_mn(source) phi_mn(probe) K_m G(f_mn) / (2 mu0), phi normalised cos*cos

parameters.name: B01_hz
parameters.description: ring-down amplitude [A/m] of H_z mode 0,1 at the probe

parameters.name: B11_hz
parameters.description: ring-down amplitude [A/m] of H_z mode 1,1 at the probe

derived_values.name: A11_ez_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*f11_ez*(t - t0_ez))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: A21_ez_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*f21_ez*(t - t0_ez))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: A12_ez_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*f12_ez*(t - t0_ez))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: B10_hz_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*f10_hz*(t - t0_hz))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: B01_hz_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*f01_hz*(t - t0_hz))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: B11_hz_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*f11_hz*(t - t0_hz))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)
